page_title: REI 2-3 TOU | Reims v Toulouse 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+8' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
90+8' The resulting corner from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+8' Teddy Teuma (Reims) will take the corner.
90+8' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+8' Teddy Teuma (Reims) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line. Now Reims have a corner.
90+7' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes a direct free kick.
90+6' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
90+5' It's time for a substitution. Naatan Skytta (Toulouse) comes on in place of Aron Donnum.
90+3' Toulouse quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' 2 - 3 Goal! Sergio Akieme (Reims) scores after an assist by Reda Khadra that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:3.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.

88' Teddy Teuma sprays a wonderful pass out to Sergio Akieme (Reims), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Guillaume Restes problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
88' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
87' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
86' The corner kick from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

85' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Reims have been awarded a corner kick.

85' Reda Khadra (Reims) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Reims.
82' Today's match ends for Yunis Abdelhamid who will be replaced by Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims).
82' Teddy Teuma (Reims) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
79' Joseph Okumu (Reims) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
76' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adama Bojang (Reims) replacing Marshall Munetsi.
75' Will Still has decided to make a change. Amadou Kone (Reims) replaces Benjamin Stambouli.
74' Yann Gboho comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse).
74' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Shavy Babicka is replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikkel Desler trots off the pitch and is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
72' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle after Teddy Teuma (Reims) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
70' Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
69' What a chance that is! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
68' Reda Khadra (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
67' Toulouse couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
64' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
64' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) makes a slide tackle, but referee Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul.
63' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Amir Richardson will be replaced by Therence Koudou (Reims).
63' Substitution. Niklas Schmidt makes his way off the pitch and Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) comes on as his replacement.
62' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Teddy Teuma (Reims) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Guillaume Restes to dive and make a save.
55' Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.
54' Sergio Akieme (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
54' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

52' Sergio Akieme sprays a wonderful pass out to Amir Richardson (Reims), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Guillaume Restes problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
50' It should have been a goal! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!

49' 1 - 3 Goal! Teddy Teuma (Reims) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Guillaume Restes had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:3.
48' Reims enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Will Still makes a switch. Sergio Akieme is coming on in place of Thibault De Smet (Reims) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Pierre Gaillouste has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 0 - 3 Goal! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Yehvann Diouf.
45+2' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' It’s a PENALTY to Toulouse after the VAR review!
45+1' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Toulouse! Let's see what he decides.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
45' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Thibault De Smet (Reims).
44' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Teddy Teuma (Reims), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
42' Reda Khadra (Reims) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

42' Reda Khadra (Reims) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
40' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
39' Teddy Teuma (Reims) steps up to send the ball in.
39' Reda Khadra (Reims) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
39' Reda Khadra (Reims) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
38' An attempted cross from Reda Khadra (Reims) is cleared.
38' Reda Khadra (Reims) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.

38' Reda Khadra (Reims) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' Reda Khadra (Reims) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.

31' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Yehvann Diouf, so the score changes to 0:2.
30' Yehvann Diouf leaps to intercept the corner kick from Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
30' What a chance! Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.

28' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
28' Reda Khadra (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' Reda Khadra finds Mohamed Daramy (Reims) after some good work, but from the edge of the box he skews his attempted shot well wide of the right post.
25' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' Free kick. Toulouse will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Thibault De Smet (Reims) gets a yellow card.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) only has the keeper to beat after a fine cross from Reda Khadra, but he fluffs his lines from close in and sends the ball miles wide of the right post.
18' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
16' Rough tackle by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' 0 - 1 Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
10' The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The foul by Marshall Munetsi (Reims) was seen by Pierre Gaillouste who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' The ball is cleared after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Reda Khadra (Reims) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
2' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a cross from the corner, but Yehvann Diouf reads it well and gathers the ball.
2' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
